name: encoding.toml
doc:
TOML 1.0: parsing to a dynamic Value tree with the full set of value
types (strings in all four forms, integers in all bases, floats with
inf/nan, booleans, offset/local datetimes, local dates and times,
arrays, inline tables), tables, arrays of tables, dotted keys and the
redefinition rules; Format<T>/Parse<T> through compile-time reflection
with @toml(name:, omitEmpty:, skip:, inline:) and @serde; and Document,
a parsed file that keeps comments, order and layout for in-place edits
(Set / Delete change only the affected lines).

items.name: Decode
items.doc: Decode maps a parsed Value into a T (the rules of Parse).
items.summary: Decode maps a parsed Value into a T (the rules of Parse).

items.name: Format
items.doc:
The TOML document of v (a struct or map: keys first, then tables and
arrays of tables; map keys sorted). Nil pointers and slices are left
out (TOML has no null).
items.summary: The TOML document of v (a struct or map: keys first, then tables and arrays of tables; map keys sorted).

items.name: NewArray
items.doc: NewArray returns an array of copies of items.
items.summary: NewArray returns an array of copies of items.

items.name: NewDateTime
items.doc: A datetime value from its TOML text (validated).
items.summary: A datetime value from its TOML text (validated).

items.name: NewTable
items.signature: func NewTable(keys []string, values []Value, inline bool) Value!
items.doc: A table; inline tables are written as {k = v} when formatted.
items.summary: A table; inline tables are written as {k = v} when formatted.

items.name: Parse
items.summary: Parses a document into a T (tables to structs by @toml(name:) / @serde(name:) / field name, maps with string keys, slices from arrays and arrays of tables, scalars, datetimes into strings).

items.name: ParseValue
items.doc: Parses a TOML document into its root table.
items.summary: Parses a TOML document into its root table.

items.name: ToValue
items.doc: The dynamic Value of v (kind 0 for nil pointers, which tables skip).
items.summary: The dynamic Value of v (kind 0 for nil pointers, which tables skip).

items.name: Document
items.doc:
A TOML file that keeps its text: Set and Delete splice the affected
lines only, so comments, order and layout survive.
items.summary: A TOML file that keeps its text: Set and Delete splice the affected lines only, so comments, order and layout survive.

members.name: String
members.doc: The text of the document.
members.summary: The text of the document.

members.name: Tree
members.doc: The parsed tree.
members.summary: The parsed tree.

members.name: Get
members.doc:
The value at a dotted path ("package.name", "deps.\"a.b\""); the
zero Value if absent.
members.summary: The value at a dotted path ("package.name", "deps.\"a.b\""); the zero Value if absent.

members.name: Has
members.doc: Has reports whether the dotted path exists in the document.
members.summary: Has reports whether the dotted path exists in the document.

members.name: Set
members.signature: func Set(path string, v Value) void!
members.doc:
Sets the value at path: replaces an existing value in place (its
comment stays), or adds `key = value` at the end of the key's table,
creating a [table] section at the end of the file if needed.
members.summary: Sets the value at path: replaces an existing value in place (its comment stays), or adds `key = value` at the end of the key's table, creating a [table] section at the end of the file if needed.

members.name: Delete
members.doc: Removes the key at path (its whole line); false if it was absent.
members.summary: Removes the key at path (its whole line); false if it was absent.

items.name: Value
items.doc: A TOML value. Datetimes keep their text (DateKind tells which form).

members.name: IsString
members.doc: IsString reports whether the value is a string.
members.summary: IsString reports whether the value is a string.

members.name: IsInt
members.doc: IsInt reports whether the value is an integer.
members.summary: IsInt reports whether the value is an integer.

members.name: IsFloat
members.doc: IsFloat reports whether the value is a float.
members.summary: IsFloat reports whether the value is a float.

members.name: IsBool
members.doc: IsBool reports whether the value is a boolean.
members.summary: IsBool reports whether the value is a boolean.

members.name: IsDateTime
members.doc: IsDateTime reports whether the value is a date, time or datetime.
members.summary: IsDateTime reports whether the value is a date, time or datetime.

members.name: IsArray
members.doc: IsArray reports whether the value is an array.
members.summary: IsArray reports whether the value is an array.

members.name: IsTable
members.doc: IsTable reports whether the value is a table.
members.summary: IsTable reports whether the value is a table.

members.name: IsObject
members.doc: IsObject is IsTable under the name shared with json.Value and yaml.Value.
members.summary: IsObject is IsTable under the name shared with json.Value and yaml.Value.

members.name: Type
members.doc: "string", "int", "float", "bool", "datetime", "array", "table" ("none" for the zero Value).
members.summary: "string", "int", "float", "bool", "datetime", "array", "table" ("none" for the zero Value).

members.name: DateKind
members.doc: For datetimes: "offset-datetime", "local-datetime", "local-date" or "local-time".
members.summary: For datetimes: "offset-datetime", "local-datetime", "local-date" or "local-time".

members.name: String
members.doc: String returns the string; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: String returns the string; an error for other kinds.

members.name: Int
members.doc: Int returns the integer; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: Int returns the integer; an error for other kinds.

members.name: Float
members.doc: Float returns the number (integers convert); an error for other kinds.
members.summary: Float returns the number (integers convert); an error for other kinds.

members.name: Bool
members.doc: Bool returns the boolean; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: Bool returns the boolean; an error for other kinds.

members.name: DateTime
members.doc: The text of a datetime as written (normalized: T separator, Z upper case).
members.summary: The text of a datetime as written (normalized: T separator, Z upper case).

members.name: Len
members.doc: Len returns the number of elements of an array or keys of a table (0 otherwise).
members.summary: Len returns the number of elements of an array or keys of a table (0 otherwise).

members.name: Index
members.doc: Index returns element i of an array (the zero Value if out of range).
members.summary: Index returns element i of an array (the zero Value if out of range).

members.name: Get
members.doc: The value at key (a single key, not a dotted path), or the zero Value.
members.summary: The value at key (a single key, not a dotted path), or the zero Value.

members.name: At
members.doc: The value at a dotted path like "server.ports" or "a.\"b.c\"".
members.summary: The value at a dotted path like "server.ports" or "a.\"b.c\"".

members.name: Has
members.doc: Has reports whether a table has key.
members.summary: Has reports whether a table has key.

members.name: Keys
members.doc: Keys returns the keys of a table in document order.
members.summary: Keys returns the keys of a table in document order.

members.name: Items
members.doc: Items returns the elements of an array (or the values of a table) as a new slice.
members.summary: Items returns the elements of an array (or the values of a table) as a new slice.

members.name: Format
members.doc: TOML text of a table (a document), or the inline form of another value.
members.summary: TOML text of a table (a document), or the inline form of another value.
